baselines.spectral_signatures: top singular-vector squared projection after trusted-reference coordinate standardization
baselines.spectre_que: trusted-reference robust whitening followed by quantum-entropy covariance scoring
baselines.activation_clustering: PCA-16 plus two-cluster k-means; anomalous cluster is farther from the trusted centroid
baselines.scan_style: PCA-16 two-component shared-covariance Gaussian mixture with likelihood-ratio scoring

fidelity_note: SPECTRE/QUE and SCAn-style are clean-room mechanism baselines under the paper's external-reference protocol, not bit-identical reproductions of their authors' full pipelines.
thresholding: all methods use the same independent clean calibration ranks; poison labels are used only after scoring
